cues: Blood is held at seven point four by carbonic acid and bicarbonate.
Acidic hill soils in Nepal are limed to hold their p H. Electroplating, brewing, curd making and dyeing all need a fixed p H. Eye drops and injections are buffered to match body fluids.
And E D T A titrations run in an ammonia buffer at p H ten.
text: Buffers are everywhere. Blood is held at seven point four by carbonic acid and bicarbonate. Cell fluid uses phosphate. Acidic hill soils in Nepal are limed to hold their p H. Electroplating, brewing, curd making and dyeing all need a fixed p H. Eye drops and injections are buffered to match body fluids. And E D T A titrations run in an ammonia buffer at p H ten.
